manifest.title: Cloudflare (Workers + D1 + Vue)
manifest.description: Runs on Cloudflare: a Worker for the API, D1 (SQLite) for data, and a Vue screen served as static assets from the same Worker. Developed and checked on this computer with wrangler dev, then published with wrangler deploy after approval. A free Cloudflare account is enough to start.

spec.title: Write the spec
spec.description: Fills in the spec templates for the base and the use case from the answers to the questions. Anything not yet decided goes on a list.

prerequisites.title: Check the tools
prerequisites.description: Checks Node (22 or later) and yarn. wrangler is installed in the project, so it is not needed here.

scaffold.title: App skeleton
scaffold.description: Creates the Worker API, D1, the Vue screens and the starting point for tests that run on Workers, all in one folder.

data.title: Data shape
data.description: Turns the "things it handles" in the spec into D1 tables, and writes migrations and tests.

api.title: API
api.description: Turns the operations in the spec into a Worker API, checks what comes in, and writes tests.

ui.title: Screens
ui.description: Builds the screens in the spec with Vue and connects them to the API.

auth.title: Sign-in
auth.description: Adds the sign-in method in the spec. Anyone can open the published app, so without sign-in, what may be shown is limited as the spec says.

run-check.title: Start it and check
run-check.description: Builds it, starts it on this computer with wrangler dev, and checks that the screens and the API respond.

security.title: Security check
security.description: Reads what was built the way an attacker would, following OWASP Top 10:2025, fixes the holes that can be exploited, confirms the fixes with tests, and writes a report. The result is checked by sending the Worker running on this computer requests shaped like real attacks (changes from another site, broken JSON).

deploy.title: Publish to Cloudflare
deploy.description: Creates the D1 database, applies the migrations, and publishes with wrangler deploy. Checks that the published URL serves this build.

handover.title: How to use it, and handover
handover.description: Writes in the README and the getting-started page the published URL, how to run it on this computer, the steps for the next change, and how to back up the data.
